usage: The word '家口' (gaa1 hau2) refers to members of a family or household.
'家口' is used to talk about the people living in a home, not just relatives by blood.
You can use '家口' when counting or referring to the number of people in your household.
It can be used in both formal and casual contexts when discussing family or living arrangements.
'家口' is generally treated as a singular noun referring collectively to a group.
